data.title: Sky Residences
data.about:
Seamlessly integrating aesthetics and comfort, Sky Residences in Expo City will offer an extraordinary lifestyle. The apartment complex by Expo Dubai Group will provide residents with 1 to 3-bedroom apartments available in a range of layouts varying from 77.46 to 178.20 square meters. 

The development aims to redefine urban luxury, featuring spacious balconies, awe-inspiring views, and eco-friendly amenities. Easy access to key locations through motorways and a dedicated metro stop enhances its appeal, ensuring a luxurious lifestyle in harmony with nature.

Sky Residences Expo City is a part of Expo Central that comprises three residential complexes, each conveniently located within a brief five-minute stroll from the city's major landmarks, road networks, and attractions. Expo City has launched a couple of new projects, like Maha Villas and Mangrove Residences, elevating the standards of sustainable urban-style living in the city.

characteristics_module.title: A Blend of Luxurious Comfort with Contemporary Design
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Featuring 1 to 3-bedroom apartments with spacious balconies
  • Comprises state-of-the-art gyms and pools
  • 45,000 square meters of lush parks and gardens
  • Easy walks to several attractions
  • Offering views of the Al Wasl Plaza
  • Flexible 5-year post-handover payment plan

location_tile.title: A lifestyle blending modern amenities with a touch of natural beauty
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Sky Residences will be a fantastic addition to the luxury properties in Expo City, a thriving hub of cultural diversity, cutting-edge architecture, and unparalleled connectivity. The district is a nexus of convenience and cosmopolitan charm, providing easy access to major roads and dedicated metro stations.

  • 15 mins - The View at The Palm, Palm Jumeirah
  • 15 mins - Riverland Dubai
  • 16 mins - Dubai Marina
  • 30 mins - Downtown Dubai
